summary: Iteration 2 — re-verified previously-fixed backend + all newly-requested frontend changes on the Project 7 Figure landing page. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (previously critical GET /api/applications 500 is now fixed — response model tolerates legacy documents). Frontend: All new changes verified visually and programmatically — logo image removed from Nav/Hero/Footer/MoneyBack (0 img elements in each), Bodoni Moda + Manrope premium fonts applied, 'Only 10 seats per month' heading reduced to 120px (was 240px), '10' stays inline, compensation numbers ₹12-14 / ₹15-18 / ₹18+ each render on a single visual line with LPA inline (verified via bounding-box y-coords), new decorative CreativeSeal renders with 2 SVGs, curved textPath, 60 tick marks, CERTIFIED + 100% + Placement Guarantee labels, and the customer-assets/Gemini_Generated logo URL is NOT fetched by the app (0 network requests). Application form submits end-to-end successfully — success screen + sonner toast appear.

issues: At 1920px viewport, 'A career worthy of' wraps to two lines ('A career worthy' / 'of') due to max-w-[1100px] container. Not a bug (no clipping — descenders on 'y' and 'g' fully visible per the review request) but arguably still not ideal from a typographic standpoint. If the intent was 'A career worthy of' on one line, consider increasing max-width or slightly reducing font-size clamp.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove /app/frontend/src/lib/brand.js — it still exports the old BRAND_LOGO_URL constant referencing customer-assets. Currently unused (nothing imports it), so no runtime impact, but it should be deleted for hygiene since logos have been intentionally removed.
(Optional polish) Consider widening hero headline container so 'A career worthy of' fits on one line at desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice fix: Application response model in server.py now sets full_name/native_state/etc. defaults to '' with model_config extra='ignore' — this correctly resolves the previous ResponseValidationError on legacy docs missing native_state.
IntakeAndGuarantee.jsx CreativeSeal is a large inline component (~150 lines) inside the same file. Consider extracting to its own file (e.g. components/site/CreativeSeal.jsx) for readability.
/app/frontend/src/lib/brand.js is now dead code — a stale reference to the removed logo URL. Delete it (leaving the constant makes the review reviewer/greppers falsely think the logo is still wired).

Hero component: `max-w-[1100px]` on the h1 combined with `fontSize: clamp(52px, 9.5vw, 152px)` causes 'A career worthy of' to wrap at 1920px viewport. Not clipping, but visually reads as 3 lines instead of the intended 2.
ApplyForm still has 12 duplicate `field-*` inputs without shared config; consider a form-schema-driven render for maintainability.

(2) Fonts are Bodoni Moda (headline) + Manrope (body). (3) Intake heading fontSize=120px at 1920w (was 240px). rca of the issue: N/A — no issues in this iteration. Prior iteration's GET /api/applications 500 has been correctly resolved by making Application response-model fields default to empty strings with ConfigDict(extra='ignore'), so legacy Mongo documents missing native_state now serialise cleanly.
